**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Declare build-script dependency for non-Windows builds**

Because `winresource` is declared only under `[target.'cfg(windows)'.build-dependencies]`, Linux/macOS builds of this workspace do not make that crate available to `build.rs`; Rust still resolves `winresource::WindowsResource` while compiling the build script before the runtime `CARGO_CFG_TARGET_OS` branch can skip it. This breaks the intended non-Windows tray stub for `cargo check/test --workspace`; make the build dependency unconditional or compile-gate the reference in a way that still supports Windows targets.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
